Item.Name: Parameters.CreateIfMissing.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Leave false. Set true only after the person has explicitly confirmed that no existing tender matches and a new one should be created.

Item.Name: Parameters.InsertedCount.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Schedule lines inserted by this call.

Item.Name: Parameters.LinesJson.Sys_Description
Item.Value: The Schedule Extractor's JSON envelope exactly as the skill returned it. Never summarised, shortened or reformatted.

Item.Name: Parameters.OpportunityCreated.Sys_Description
Item.Value: True when this call created the tender. Tell the person when it is true.

Item.Name: Parameters.OpportunityId.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Leave empty in chat. For process-to-process calls only; when set, TenderReference is ignored.

Item.Name: Parameters.ResolvedOpportunity.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Title of the tender the lines were written to. Read it back to the person.

Item.Name: Parameters.RunSummary.Sys_Description
Item.Value: One sentence to relay in chat.

Item.Name: Parameters.SkippedCount.Sys_Description
Item.Value: Lines already present and skipped, so a re-run never duplicates.

Item.Name: Parameters.TenderReference.Sys_Description
Item.Value: The tender as the person named it: a tender code such as TND-2026-0141, the opportunity title, or its id. Required unless OpportunityId is sent.
